title: WAN Backup-Link Quota Snapshot
description: Schema for the JSON file written by a quota provider plugin. Read by failover-monitor's _backup_quota_cap helper and by quota-hard-block.sh.

limit_pct.description: Percentage of monthly data quota consumed on the backup link. null = unknown or no quota configured upstream.

collected_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the upstream API was queried. failover-monitor uses file mtime for staleness, so this is informational/observability only.

provider.description: Free-text identifier of the quota provider. E.g. 'netgear-lm1200', 'huawei-e8372', 'isp-portal-screenscrape'.

billing_cycle_days_left.description: Optional. Days until the upstream billing cycle resets. Lets the quota hard block (QUOTA_HARD_BLOCK) recognise a new cycle even when the counter reads exactly 0 — the block itself drops the traffic that would otherwise move the counter. Omit it if the upstream API does not expose it.
